reviews.title: Only 6 months in a Vantrue N5 car camera system
reviews.body: It only worked for 6 months in a Vantrue N5 4 channel camera system. I paid extra for the High Endurance version so it would last, but it didn't. I bought Sandisk because I thought it would last longer, but it didn't. For the price I expected to get 2 years out of the Sandisk High Endurance model. I'm in Washington state, so the solar heating on it wasn't crazy like it would be in southern states. The camera was only on for 60 minutes per day, to and from work and lunch drives. This SD card should have handled it. Save your money and buy some thing less expense and expect to replace it in the same mount of time.

reviews.title: Definitely not buying from them anymore .terrible customer service
reviews.body: ⭐️ 1 Star The memory card stopped working, and I followed all the steps recommended by the manufacturer. I contacted the company to request a replacement, but they told me I had to send them the defective card first before they would send me a new one. In my opinion, that’s a terrible way to handle a warranty claim. If the product is defective, the customer shouldn’t have to be left without a memory card while waiting for the company to receive and process the damaged one. For a product that is supposed to be durable and reliable, I’m very disappointed with both the product and the warranty experience. I would not recommend this product and I would not buy it again.
reviews.review_id: jency solis|August 23, 2026|Definitely not buying from the

reviews.title: Amazon Resale card triggered a capacity warning
reviews.body: I purchased the 256GB SanDisk High Endurance card from Amazon Resale for use in a Tapo C720 security camera. Immediately after installation, the Tapo app warned that the card had an “unusually expanded capacity” that could jeopardize stored data and advised replacing it. The card’s specifications should be compatible with this camera, so the problem appears to involve the particular Resale unit I received rather than necessarily the SanDisk product line. I returned it and would recommend buying this type of memory card new from an authorized seller rather than through Amazon Resale.

reviews.title: Buyer Beware!! Less than 32G on a 256G card
reviews.body: Purchased this item for my dash cam. I've purchased this item multiple times and had no issues. For whatever reason, with the particular card I received, it only records about 20 videos. I did some research and after checking the card, even though it says 256G, it has less than 32G of storage on the actual card, therefore all of my other videos were being over written and are now permanently lost. :( I wish I would have noticed this earlier. Now I cannot return or exchange the card, nor can I recuperate my files. I'm so heartbroken. If you get one that actually works, then yes I recommend. But this last one that I received was definitely counterfeit and was ordered directly from here.

reviews.title: Overheats too easily.
reviews.body: Purchased this because it was supposed to be extremely heat tolerant - it was one of only 2 recommended cards for my camera. I’m constantly getting messages from my camera about the card running too slow and not keeping up with the video feed when it gets hot. I live in Texas and have this in a dash camera. The overheating started in mid-March when outside temperatures were in the upper 70s and the card was less than a month out of the box. I doubt it will survive a Texas summer in a vehicle. I will be buying the Samsung card next time.
